name: Cychlorphine
summary: Cychlorphine is a synthetic opioid chemical compound sold as a designer drug which has been linked to hospitalizations and fatal overdoses in the United States, Europe and Canada. It is similar in chemical structure to known opioid agonists such as brorphine and spirochlorphine. It is suggested to be more potent than fentanyl. It is not a structural analog of morphine, despite the similar name.
